standard.title: Deliver presentations with purpose
standard.description: create, rehearse and deliver short oral and/or multimodal presentations for familiar audiences and purposes, using text structure appropriate to purpose and topic-specific vocabulary, and varying tone, volume and pace
standard.prior_knowledge: Students create and deliver short presentations with clear structure, topic vocabulary and appropriate gesture, volume and pace (AC9E1LY07). They have not yet deliberately rehearsed presentations or varied tone, volume and pace as purposeful delivery strategies.
standard.progression_endpoint: Students can create, rehearse and deliver short oral or multimodal presentations for familiar audiences and purposes, varying tone, volume and pace.

nodes.label: Planning structure and vocabulary
nodes.progression_checkpoint: Students can plan a short presentation with a structure appropriate to its purpose and identify topic-specific vocabulary they will use.
nodes.minimum_width: Plan a presentation with an identifiable structure (e.g. introduction, key points, conclusion) and identify at least two topic-specific vocabulary items to use.
nodes.typical_width: Plan presentations across different purposes — informative, persuasive — using structures appropriate to each, identifying topic-specific vocabulary and sequencing ideas or events logically.
wider: Compare the planning structure for an informative vs a persuasive presentation and discuss what changes
Plan a multimodal presentation, deciding which ideas will be communicated through speech vs through visual elements
success_criteria: Student plans a presentation with an identifiable structure appropriate to its purpose.
Student identifies at least two topic-specific vocabulary items to use in the presentation.

nodes.label: Rehearsing
nodes.progression_checkpoint: Students can rehearse a presentation, practising appropriate tone, volume and pace.
nodes.minimum_width: Rehearse a presentation at least once and identify one aspect of delivery (tone, volume or pace) to improve.
nodes.typical_width: Rehearse presentations using feedback — self, peer or teacher — to improve delivery elements including volume, pace and tone; practise adjusting volume and tone for more formal delivery contexts.
wider: Rehearse with a specific audience in mind and discuss how the delivery changes for different audiences
Record a rehearsal and use the recording to identify specific delivery improvements

response_modes.reason: Rehearsal requires repetition — practising the same presentation multiple times with deliberate attention to delivery elements. The productive investment is repeated practice with feedback, not widening delivery contexts before the basics are established.

success_criteria: Student rehearses the presentation and identifies at least one delivery element to improve.
Student implements at least one change in the final delivery based on rehearsal.

nodes.label: Delivering with varied tone, volume and pace
nodes.progression_checkpoint: Students can deliver a presentation varying tone, volume and pace deliberately to serve the purpose and engage the audience.
nodes.minimum_width: Deliver a presentation with at least one deliberate variation in tone, volume or pace.
nodes.typical_width: Deliver presentations with varied tone, volume and pace appropriate to purpose — adjusting for more formal situations — and use topic-specific vocabulary consistently.
wider: Evaluate their own or a peer's delivery using specific criteria for tone, volume and pace, and discuss what the variation achieved
Deliver the same content with two different delivery styles (e.g. formal vs informal) and discuss the effect on the audience
success_criteria: Student delivers a presentation with at least one variation in tone, volume or pace.
Student uses topic-specific vocabulary in the delivered presentation.
Student maintains appropriate delivery for the context — volume audible, pace not rushed — throughout.
